lines.say: the scalp form regrows hair on top of the scalp over months; loss resumes if stopped
tablets for hair loss (off-label) were no better than the scalp form in 90 men
tablets lower blood pressure in severe, hard-to-control cases
heart rate can rise, with lightheadedness (about 1% to 2% on tablets for hair)
extra face and body hair on tablets: about 80% for blood pressure, 15% to 49% for hair
tablets' boxed warning: fluid around the heart, sometimes compressing it, and angina
fluid retention with swelling: 7% on blood pressure tablets, about 1% for hair
scalp form: scalp irritation and unwanted facial hair

ask: Would tablets or a scalp product suit me better, given my heart health and blood pressure?
